question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q4_2019_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS q4_2020_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
qualified_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE q4_2019_sales > 0
      AND 1.0 * (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) / q4_2019_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS product_city_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualified_cities)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(product_city_sales) AS overall_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, overall_sales,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY overall_sales DESC) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_cnt
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20 AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM top_products
    WHERE rn <= CAST(total_cnt * 0.20 AS INTEGER)
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, SUM(product_city_sales) AS total_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT cps.prod_id, cps.calendar_year, cps.product_city_sales, qt.total_sales,
       1.0 * cps.product_city_sales / qt.total_sales AS share
FROM city_product_sales cps
JOIN quarter_totals qt ON cps.calendar_year = qt.calendar_year
JOIN top_20 tp ON cps.prod_id = tp.prod_id
WHERE cps.prod_id IN (18, 15)
